main.description: Take a recovery key off the group's did:plc. This host's own key cannot be removed this way. Requires group.configure.

group.description: The group DID. Every method is served by the group's host and authorized against that group's roles.

key.description: A did:key (secp256k1 or P-256). Only the public key: the host never sees the private half.

errors.name: InvalidOperation
errors.description: The PLC directory refused the change, as when another was made first: ask again.
